# Corporate users — Services available now

How do I manage, contain, monitor and ensure compliance of the agents already running? These are services you can engage now — some are live products, some are designs delivered as engagements.

Each row states what it is, what it runs on, and **how far along it is.**

[Download the PDF ↓](pdf/sgit-ai__04-corporate.pdf)The sheet as handed out in Lisbon. The table below is the same content, in a form a search engine and an agent can read.

## What exists

|  | The capability | What exists today |
|---|---|---|
| 07 | **A licence to operate for each agent you already run.** Powered by Risk product & free behaviour-policy library | Site v1.10, library and store live. No payment link; entry-tier application not located. |
| 08 | **Third-party and supply-chain management: what your vendors, and their agents, do with your data.** Powered by Vaults plus behaviour policies | Runs on the live vault runtime and the policy library. Not yet packaged as its own product. |
| 02 | **A folder with history for anything you send out of the building.** Powered by sgit, transfer protocol & browser vault | Live. CLI in beta; write-only intake built, never sold. |
| 03 | **Manage and distribute sensitive data — healthcare is the worked example.** Powered by Vaults on the same runtime | An MVP is built on it. |
| 04 | **Ask your next security vendor for the report as a vault rather than a PDF.** Powered by Report vault on the vault runtime | Designed 26 May. Deliverable shape built; demo specified. |
| 05 | **The board conversation, in the language and detail each executive needs.** Powered by Boardroom, agent rooms & persona machinery | Original product existed. Persona generator built in August. |
| 06 | **Briefings by role, with evidence behind every line.** Powered by Role-aware briefings on semantic graphs | Live; commercial state not verified in the brief. |
| 01 | **Debriefs from voice notes, wherever the voice already is.** Powered by Voice Debrief + WhatsApp, file & agent integrations | Live, earning, and run with a partner under a signed profit share. |

## Start with an agent you already run

**Bring one agent you already run.** You leave with a draft policy for it, corrected, as a file you keep. The library is free; the rows above state what is live and what is delivered as an engagement.

**Write to [dinis.cruz@owasp.org](mailto:dinis.cruz@owasp.org)**, or explore [the network](../network/index.md).
